note: Mechanical complexity vector source. Production-deployment runbooks frozen before any candidate run; counts are computed from the step arrays, never self-asserted. Experiment harness process counts are reported separately and do not enter this vector.

cwk-opensearch-dual-channel-v1.runbook: Production: one OpenSearch 3.3.x cluster (analysis-icu), dual-channel indices, kb_gateway integration.
upgrade_steps: verify new official distribution digest against pinned manifest
stop search write traffic (gateway maintenance flag)
verify runtime version and plugin versions, re-open indices
backup_restore_steps: register snapshot repository on pinned storage path
create snapshot of all rt055 indices
restore snapshot into empty index set
verify doc counts and probe query against expected counts

weknora-native-8d7298fb5d759973cb1e481ca.runbook: Production: one WeKnora server (sqlite engine, Lite mode) plus one local OpenAI-compatible embedding service; no external model egress.
upgrade_steps: verify new commit reachable from upstream and tree clean
build server binary from pinned commit
replace binary and run schema migration on startup
start embedding model service and wait health
start server, verify health and KB list
smoke one manual knowledge ingest and one hybrid-search
backup_restore_steps: stop server, copy sqlite database file set (db, wal, shm) to backup path
restore file set into empty data path
start server and verify knowledge counts and one hybrid-search probe
